'''Jared Goodwin The Drug Lords of Kirdo III''' is a [[Light]] Kessel Run list [[Jared Goodwin]] posted as one of the decks he was running.<ref name="list-49995">[http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/49995.html? swccg-discussion message #49995], [[Jared Goodwin]] (1 July 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000110061401/http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/49995.html? Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Jared Goodwin]]
* '''Published:''' 1 July 1998 (swccg-discussion)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]] (from the card pool)

== Strategy ==

The list makes one-turn Kessel Runs from a parsec 1 or 2 system. Tibrin is a spare if both Kessel systems are gone.
